chapter.1.desc: Wastes at the edge of the Mist. Wraiths and hounds with crystals on their backs roam here.
chapter.1.name: Misty Wastes
chapter.2.desc: A cathedral under water. Light falls through the rose window; eels swim in the naves.
chapter.2.name: Sunken Cathedral
chapter.3.desc: A volcanic demon forge. Rivers of lava flow across the ground.
chapter.3.name: Crucible of the Abyss
chapter.4.desc: The edge of the world, where the Sun froze forever in eclipse. Light and dark wage war on themselves here.
chapter.4.name: Twilight Reach
chapter.5.desc: The Storm King's fortress among the clouds. The last path from the Twilight Reach leads here.
chapter.5.name: Sky Citadel
chapter.6.desc: The crack in the sky behind the Storm King’s throne. A void of dead stars where every creature strikes back.
chapter.6.name: Star Rift
dungeon.crypt.desc: A flooded knights' crypt. Weapons and armor of every set are found here.
dungeon.crypt.name: Gear Crypt
dungeon.forgevault.desc: The demons' treasury. Awakening Stones and rare summon scrolls.
dungeon.forgevault.name: Crucible Vault
dungeon.skyspire.desc: The Storm King's treasury above the clouds. The only source of the Cruelty, Titan and Tempest sets.
dungeon.skyspire.name: Sky Spire
dungeon.starcave.desc: Grains of the shattered sun fall here. Star Dust and XP Tomes.
dungeon.starcave.name: Star Cave

hero.aerin.lore: An elven mercenary the dwarves pay in pure gold. She works fast, haggles long and never misses.
hero.aerin.name: Aerin
hero.aerin.title: Blade for Gold
hero.ardan.lore: The last knight to see the whole Sun. He carries a shard of it in his sword's hilt.
hero.ardan.name: Ardan
hero.ardan.title: Knight of Dawn
hero.aurel.lore: Keeps the world's last noon in a glass lamp. While it burns, no one nearby falls.
hero.aurel.name: Aurel
hero.aurel.title: Noon Warden
hero.azgar.lore: His familiar is an eye that sees weak spots.
hero.azgar.name: Azgar
hero.azgar.title: Warlock
hero.brum.lore: His beard has seen more battles than he has.
hero.brum.name: Brum
hero.brum.title: Clan Shield
hero.chirk.lore: Fled the Abyss for the Camp's pies.
hero.chirk.name: Chirk
hero.chirk.title: Mischief Imp
hero.dorn.lore: Brews ale better than he forges. For now.
hero.dorn.name: Dorn
hero.dorn.title: Apprentice
hero.elvira.lore: The last mistress of a castle at the edge of the wastes. She drinks only the blood of those who serve the Mist — and is very picky about the taste.
hero.elvira.name: Elvira
hero.elvira.title: Crimson Countess
hero.fyu.name: Fyu
hero.fyu.title: Firefly Fairy
hero.gorran.lore: A mountain that one day decided to get up and protect those who lived at its foot.
hero.gorran.name: Gorran
hero.gorran.title: Heart of the Mountain
hero.grav.lore: Guards a crypt, though he long ago forgot whose.
hero.grav.name: Grav
hero.grav.title: Bone Warden
hero.grimsa.lore: Believes any problem can be solved with a bigger caliber.
hero.grimsa.name: Grimsa
hero.grimsa.title: Cannoneer
hero.grom.lore: Worked as a bouncer in an Abyss tavern. Loved the job.
hero.grom.name: Grom
hero.grom.title: Ogre Bruiser
hero.ifrita.lore: Daughter of the Crucible. Her hair burns brighter when she's angry.
hero.ifrita.name: Ifrita
hero.ifrita.title: Mistress of Flame
hero.ilia.lore: Four oaths of the Order merged into one — and so was born the one who brings the dawn back to the fallen.
hero.ilia.name: Ilia
hero.ilia.title: Sunfaced
hero.iren.lore: Shoots only at dusk, when the stars are out but the Mist is not yet.
hero.iren.name: Iren
hero.iren.title: Star Archer
hero.ivy.lore: Wherever she walks, the grass grows faster.
hero.ivy.name: Ivy
hero.ivy.title: Brook Dryad
hero.karr.lore: Half bird, half a cloud of gnats.
hero.karr.name: Karr
hero.karr.title: Plague Raven
hero.kharras.lore: He left the Abyss when he realized the Mist would devour it too.
hero.kharras.name: Kharras
hero.kharras.title: Prince of Ash
hero.liel.lore: Her arrows grow right out of her bow.
hero.liel.name: Liel
hero.liel.title: Thorn Archer
hero.lilith.lore: She sold dreams to the demons of the Crucible until she saw the Devourer in a dream. Since then she sells only nightmares — to its servants.
hero.lilith.name: Lilith
hero.lilith.title: Succubus of the Crucible
hero.marina.lore: A diver from the same sunken port as Mirna. She found a pearl on the seabed that glows like a dawn shard.
hero.marina.name: Marina
hero.marina.title: Pearl Maiden
hero.mirna.lore: She grew up in the harbor town that was the first to sink beneath the waves.
hero.mirna.name: Mirna
hero.mirna.title: Spearmaiden
hero.morok.lore: No one has seen his face twice. They say he stole the Mist's laughter.
hero.morok.name: Morok
hero.morok.title: Twilight Jester
hero.mortis.lore: Returns to the living the strength he took from the dead.
hero.mortis.name: Mortis
hero.mortis.title: Ash Priest
hero.nocta.lore: She dances on the border of light and shadow. Her blades leave wounds that blacken by morning.
hero.nocta.name: Nocta
hero.nocta.title: Twilight Widow
hero.olkha.lore: When the Mist burned her grove, she took the shape of a beast and never changed back.
hero.olkha.name: Olkha
hero.olkha.title: Bear Druid
hero.ragna.lore: She swore to protect the living — and kept her oath even after death.
hero.ragna.name: Ragna
hero.ragna.title: Death Knight
hero.rikht.lore: Dreams of earning a shard of his own one day.
hero.rikht.name: Rikht
hero.rikht.title: Squire
hero.saira.lore: Talks to the wind and sometimes argues with it.
hero.saira.name: Saira
hero.saira.title: Windcaller
hero.selesta.lore: A blind priestess who can hear where the Mist is thinnest.
hero.selesta.name: Celeste
hero.selesta.title: Priestess of Daybreak
hero.sigrun.lore: Escorts fallen dwarves to the halls — and sometimes brings them back.
hero.sigrun.name: Sigrun
hero.sigrun.title: Rune Valkyrie
hero.sirra.lore: A former overseer of the Abyss forges.
hero.sirra.name: Sirra
hero.sirra.title: Fire Whip
hero.skarn.lore: Forged in the Crucible from four demons. He remembers every voice — and they all crave fire.
hero.skarn.name: Skarn
hero.skarn.title: Lord of Ash
hero.solarion.lore: Emperor of the fallen Sun. His crown is the last ray that still warms Kaelmor.
hero.solarion.name: Solarion
hero.solarion.title: Sun Emperor
hero.taira.lore: Leader of an amazon pride from the southern thickets. She says the Mist smells of wet fur and can’t stand it.
hero.taira.name: Taira
hero.taira.title: Warrior of the Pride
hero.thalassa.lore: She remembers the world before the flood. The tides obey her voice like children.
hero.thalassa.name: Thalassa
hero.thalassa.title: Lady of the Deep
hero.tirn.lore: He is three hundred years old and still thinks of himself as a sapling.
hero.tirn.name: Tirn
hero.tirn.title: Treeguard
hero.tobias.name: Tobias
hero.tobias.title: Crossbowman
hero.torvald.lore: He forged the first seal that holds back the Mist.
hero.torvald.name: Torvald
hero.torvald.title: Rune Hammer
hero.valeria.lore: Carries the Order's banner into battle and a hammer blessed in the last dawn.
hero.valeria.name: Valeria
hero.valeria.title: Dawn Paladin
hero.veila.lore: Even the long-drowned can hear her song.
hero.veila.name: Veila
hero.veila.title: Mourner of the Deep
hero.verdis.lore: Verdis's roots have grown through every world. Each of her leaves is a life saved.
hero.verdis.name: Verdis
hero.verdis.title: World Tree
hero.vint.lore: Built a turret out of an old cauldron and is proud of it.
hero.vint.name: Vint
hero.vint.title: Engineer
hero.whisper.lore: No one has seen his face. Not even him.
hero.whisper.name: Whisper
hero.whisper.title: Shadow
